scope: Read-only design from checked-in source/spec artifacts. No source, build, generation, check, test, CLI, world, root, account, credential, browser, or database operation was performed.

assignment.assertion: Given the canonical dependency/tool/service registry and RFC canonicalization vectors, When the build inventory and protected release are validated, Then shared pins, pg-boss schema 44, one plugin/toolset, official typed adapters, and maintained authentication/cryptography are used; mismatched locks, duplicate tools/skills, a homemade serializer, writable runtime imports, or startup package downloads fail admission.

decision: Implement a truthful source-build inventory through Ops' existing read/release owner and registered probe path. This closes the local inventory owner gap but cannot certify the protected release while its installed manifest and authenticated owner transport are absent.

existingOwnerAndDeletionTest.publicOwner: Extend OpsControlRead.doctor/read.release in packages/ops/src/public.ts; keep the registry/lock parser private in packages/ops/src/build-inventory.ts. Use trustedCheckoutRoot() from packages/ops/src/checkout-root.ts, with no caller-supplied root, pin list, or manifest. ReplayEnvironment.runRegisteredProbe in packages/self-improvement/src/public.ts dispatches the assigned CLI probe to that Ops owner.
existingOwnerAndDeletionTest.whyOps: Ops already owns the existing read.release/doctor surface, service status, shared PostgreSQL/pg-boss pins, and native release eligibility policy. The implementation remains behind the existing public Ops boundary; it does not import protected control code or add a second release authority.
existingOwnerAndDeletionTest.deletionTest: The private inventory module earns its place only if it owns lock/manifest/generated-inventory reconciliation and returns one stable read result; deleting it would move this parsing and drift policy into the Ops facade and probe callers. Do not add a pass-through package or a new CLI command.
existingOwnerAndDeletionTest.limits: Do not reuse NativeReleaseEligibilityProbe's in-code verified fixture as inventory. Keep read.release PENDING/NOT_IMPLEMENTED until the actual protected owner returns an authenticated, digest-bound installed-service manifest.

writtenInterface.input: Existing RegisteredProbeInputV1 through `toy probe run AT-authority-61 --json` (optional existing `--case` only for diagnosis); the probe obtains its root from trustedCheckoutRoot(). It accepts no caller-authored inventory, expected pins, arbitrary filesystem path, installed identity, or release assertion.
writtenInterface.ownerResult: Existing CheckViewV1 entries inside RegisteredProbeReportV1. Register distinct check IDs for source-lock inventory, plugin/tool/adapter inventory, canonicalization vectors, negative-control denials, and protected-release status. Each prerequisite is compact canonical JSON under the existing 2000-byte limit: schema version, source digests, row/count totals, exact mismatch/duplicate IDs, state, and reason code. Bind all inspected source/lock/vector artifacts in links.artifactDigests; do not print raw manifests, credentials, or arbitrary OS errors.

inventoryFacts.dependencies: Derive actual package rows from root and workspace package.json files plus the single package-lock.json: requested version, resolved lock version, integrity, and relative paths. Compare shared expected pins from CONTRACTS.md and the narrower Authority §20 pins against actual rows. Record absent/unresolved pins as missing, never as an inferred match. Reuse the same package/lock/module-graph inputs already read by the source parser in packages/self-improvement/src/engineering-control.ts; do not add a second general TypeScript parser or copy its inventories.
inventoryFacts.services: Use the existing serviceIdSchema in packages/contracts/src/ops-registry.ts as the canonical declared service set. Report its digest/count separately from installed services. Only a real protected installed-service manifest can populate installed state.
inventoryFacts.pluginToolsSkills: Use one generated plugin manifest and schemas from the existing contracts generator. Bind expected plugin `toy` version `1.0.0` and native toolset `toy`; the Authority tool entries are exactly toy_action_request, toy_action_enqueue, toy_action_status, toy_action_receipts, toy_calendar_undo, and toy_school_authorize. Reject toy_action_approve, duplicate tool/skill names, and competing plugin/toolset registrations. Preserve the single shared, unnamespaced toy-interact skill instead of registering a second Authority skill.
inventoryFacts.adaptersAndAuth: Inventory adapter IDs, owners, typed contract digests, package names, and lock integrities from actual generated/public manifests. Do not count packages/sources/src/adapters/k4a-reference.ts as an official live adapter. Missing protected adapter or maintained auth/crypto artifacts remain BLOCKED; do not synthesize entries from names in prose.
inventoryFacts.queue: Record pg-boss 12.36.0 and expected schema 44. Reuse the accepted AT-obligations-76 evidence digest for actual schema-44/transaction readbacks; do not repeat the database probe or claim that a source pin proves runtime schema state.
inventoryFacts.staticBoundaries: Keep the existing `npm run boundaries`/dependency-cruiser graph and `architecture/modules.json` as the import-boundary authority. Ops must not import control/authority, evaluator, publisher, or secrets; the source inventory must not scan credentials or protected runtime contents. Startup-download admission is static/source evidence only until a real protected release manifest is available.

canonicalization.pinStatus: Authority §20 proposes module-specific canonicalize 5.1.0 and says exact availability/integrity is a pre-build gate. This is not listed as a CONTRACTS shared pin and is absent from current package manifests and package-lock; mark unresolved until the exact maintained package artifact is lock-resolved.
canonicalization.verification: Once that pin is actually installed/locked, the Ops inventory validator calls the maintained library directly against a source-hashed RFC 8785 vector artifact whose expected bytes are independent of the implementation. No handwritten canonicalizer, key-sort wrapper, JSON.stringify substitute, or network download is permitted. Missing package/vector artifacts return BLOCKED, never a fallback PASS.

writtenInterface.protectedRelease: Existing read.release is currently NOT_IMPLEMENTED with OWNER_TRANSPORT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The latest doctor reports all eight role identities observed but identityGateVerified=false and maintenanceIdentityVerified=false. The output must retain protectedRelease=BLOCKED and acceptanceComplete=false; it must not treat observed UID rows, source registry names, or synthetic candidates as installed release evidence.

finiteCliOracle.execution: Run only after source admission, using the existing registered R0 test context. The later acceptance run must omit --case so every mandatory phase is exercised; per-case runs are diagnostics and do not certify the whole AT.

mandatoryCases.expected: PASS only when actual workspace manifests/lock and generated source inventory match; current missing canonicalization/auth pins and plugin manifest keep this subgate blocked or failed.
PASS only for exactly one actual generated toy plugin/toolset and typed adapter inventory; no fake/reference adapter counts as official.
Every pinned RFC vector matches the independently fixed expected canonical bytes; absent canonicalize 5.1.0 lock entry or vector artifact is BLOCKED.
A one-file disposable lock mutation is rejected by the same public CLI owner; test verdict PASS means candidate admission was denied.
A disposable duplicate tool or skill entry is rejected; test verdict PASS means candidate admission was denied.
A disposable candidate replacing the maintained serializer dependency/entry is rejected; no mutation touches protected or installed files.
A disposable runtime import crossing the existing dependency-cruiser protected boundary is rejected.
A disposable runtime-startup install/download hook is rejected; the probe performs no network access.
BLOCKED until a genuine authenticated installed-service manifest and verified identity/maintenance enforcement are supplied; this result keeps AT-authority-61 pending.

finiteCliOracle.fixtureRule: The actual-checkout source inventory is the sole positive input. Negative controls may use isolated disposable copies with one controlled mutation each, driven through the public CLI; they can prove refusal behavior only and can never populate or certify a positive inventory.

internalSourceWork: Add the typed check declarations and AT-authority-61 manifest to the existing contracts/CLI acceptance registry, then regenerate only through scripts/generate-contracts.mjs.

Implement the private Ops source inventory over actual workspace manifests, package-lock, generated artifacts, existing service/tool registries, and existing dependency graph; bind AT-authority-61 dispatch through ReplayEnvironment.
Make missing/duplicate/mismatch conditions explicit and fail closed; preserve CheckViewV1 byte limits, use actual source digests, and keep the protected release verdict pending.
Add the RFC-vector check only behind the actual maintained library pin; do not vend or hand-implement a serializer.

The checkout has no plugins/toy directory or uv.lock. The existing generator lists generated contracts/DTO artifacts but no plugin manifest artifact.
currentLocalFacts.queueProof: Existing AT-obligations-76 evidence covers the actual pg-boss schema-44 transaction/readback gate; carry its accepted digest rather than retrying it.

A separate protected owner must provide the genuine installed-service manifest and authenticated readback, plus verified identity/maintenance enforcement. No source probe can manufacture this evidence.
